acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc:
Ira Glass talks to Sam Ashner, whose debilitating fear of spiders was ruining his life. So he opted for an extraordinary treatment — the nuclear option — to deal with it.
Sam's treatment was featured in the documentary series A Cure For Fear, directed by Lana Wilson and made for Topic.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: When the United States Congress saw a problem — sex trafficking — it acted to eliminate it. Producer Lina Misitzis looked into how the law played out for its targets and the others swept up in the “fix.”
acts.title: Catching Deer When You Wanted Lions

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: For the last year, writer Karen Cheung has been watching her hometown of Hong Kong change in big and small ways under a new law, and wondering when and if leaving will be her last resort.
acts.title: The Lonely Island
